transcript: Speaker A: Everyone talks about working smarter, not harder, but nobody's talking about the actual thing that quietly drains your output every single day. I think I finally found it. Typing was the bottleneck. I found this voice dictation tool that actually picks up my words pretty accurately, and you can do cool stuff like adding emojis and auto-correcting verbal mistakes. If you wanna try out the tool, comment the word 'flow' and I'll send you the link.
on_screen_text: The productivity hack nobody talks about. Comment 'FLOW' for the link to the tool.
summary: The presenter explains how typing is a major bottleneck for capturing creative ideas on the go. He demonstrates an AI voice dictation tool called 'Flow' that filters filler words, inserts emojis, and auto-corrects mistakes. Viewers are prompted to comment 'FLOW' to get the product link.
